reports.t: 天氣／準備變天！全台下雨躲不過 回暖一天「投票日低溫探15度」 全台天氣變化劇烈，受到華南雲雨區東移影響，今晚起全台將出現降雨，預計明天下半天水氣減少，週五天氣回穩。中央氣象署預報員葉致均指出，週六新一波東北季風報到，低溫下探15度，提醒民眾留意日夜溫差。 35 分鐘前｜生活 天氣／準備變天！全台下雨躲不過 回暖一天「投票日低溫探15度」 35 分鐘前｜生活
reports.en: The weather/preparation for the weather! The rain is not going to keep us warm for a day like the 15-degree low-temperature survey on polling day, and the weather is changing so intensely that it will be affected by the east of the south China cloud. According to the Central Weather Service, the new north-east monsoon reported on Saturday, with a low temperature of 15 degrees, alerting the population to the poor weather. 35 minutes ago, the weather/preparation changed! It rained all over the station.
